name: DS Automobiles
note: French Stellantis marque; title partner of DS Penske in Formula E (2025/26) and of the France SailGP team. Left unrated for a maintainer: the owner is sourced (ds-automobiles-stellantis-ownership, stellantis-nv-record: largest holders Etablissements Peugeot Frères 7.72% and Bpifrance Participations 6.64%; France has no record in this data), but the company test isn't settled. A Georgia jury found in 2015 that Chrysler Group (now FCA US, a Stellantis company) acted with reckless or wanton disregard for human life in the design or sale of the Jeep Grand Cherokee, in the 2012 death of a four-year-old; the Georgia Court of Appeals affirmed in 2016 (https://caselaw.findlaw.com/court/ga-court-of-appeals/1754342.html). A maintainer decides whether a finding against another Stellantis company counts for DS Automobiles.
